# Mountain Villas

> Two private houses near Flúðir in South Iceland, on the Golden Circle: Mountain Villa, a log house with a glass dome, and Mountain Villa II, a new architect-designed house. Each sleeps 10 and has its own hot tub, cold plunge and sauna on a private deck. Hosted by Hafþór Júlíus Björnsson and Kelsey. Booked directly with the hosts.

## Mountain Villa
- The log house. Sleeps 10: 4 bedrooms with king beds and a sofa bed for two upstairs. 2 bathrooms.
- Private hot tub on geothermal hot water (available all year, open 24 hours), cold plunge, electric barrel sauna with a window onto the fields, outdoor shower, a glass dome on the terrace.
- For families: 2 cribs and a travel crib, 2 high chairs, a changing table, baby safety gates, toys, games and books, a swing and an outdoor play area. Frisbee golf on the grounds.
- Kitchen with induction stovetop, oven, dishwasher, Instant Pot and Nespresso. Washer, dryer, Wifi throughout, EV charger (not a fast charger), free parking. Exercise bike, free weights, yoga mats; Nintendo Wii U and PS4.
- Check-in from 16:00 with a lockbox, checkout by 10:00.
- Price: USD 887 a night, USD 842 booked on this site (5% less), all year, no cleaning fee.
- Rated 5.0 from 97 reviews on Airbnb, a Guest Favourite in the top 1% of eligible homes.
- Page: https://sindrimar02.github.io/mountain-villa-preview/villa-i.html

## Mountain Villa II
- The new house, architect designed, with floor-to-ceiling windows, vaulted timber ceilings and a wrap-around deck. Sleeps 10: 5 bedrooms (1 king bed of 200 x 220 cm, 4 queen beds). 4 full bathrooms with heated towel rails.
- Hot tub on geothermal hot water, cold plunge and electric sauna on the deck. Blackout blinds. De'Longhi espresso machine, Sonos, a TV room with a Nintendo Switch. Washer, dryer, Wifi throughout, EV charger (not a fast charger), free parking.
- For families: a high chair and a crib on request, some toys and games.
- Self check-in from 16:00 with a lockbox, checkout by 10:00.
- Price: USD 1,250 a night, USD 1,187 booked on this site (5% less), all year, no cleaning fee.
- Rated 5.0 from 8 reviews on Airbnb, a Guest Favourite.
- Page: https://sindrimar02.github.io/mountain-villa-preview/villa-ii.html

## Both houses
- Both just outside Flúðir, Hrunamannahreppur, South Iceland. Book both for up to 20 guests in 9 bedrooms.
- House rules: up to 10 overnight guests a house, no pets, no smoking or vaping, no parties or events (not for weddings, company events or training camps). No set quiet hours: there are no neighbours close by, but guests are asked to respect the houses and keep everything within limits. The person who books is 25 or older.
- Minimum stay 3 nights. Prices are in US dollars; the booking sheet shows krónur or euros as a guide. No airport transfer, tour or meal service.
- Booking: choose a house or both, dates and guests on the site and send a free request. The hosts confirm and send a secure payment link. Nothing is charged on the website.
- Hosts: Hafþór Júlíus Björnsson (World's Strongest Man 2018) and Kelsey. Phone +354 822 0377, email breyn@simnet.is.

## Location and road distances from the houses
- Flúðir: about 1.0 km by road, about 3 minutes.
- Secret Lagoon: about 2.4 km by road, about 7 minutes.
- Hrunalaug: about 4.6 km by road, about 7 minutes.
- Friðheimar: about 12 km by road, about 15 minutes.
- Skálholt: about 22 km by road, about 25 minutes.
- Laugarás Lagoon: about 23 km by road, about 23 minutes.
- Geysir: about 26 km by road, about 27 minutes.
- Gullfoss: about 33 km by road, about 32 minutes.
- Þingvellir: about 66 km by road, about 69 minutes.
- Hjálparfoss: about 44 km by road, about 40 minutes.
- Háifoss: about 62 km by road, about 71 minutes.
- Selfoss: about 46 km by road, about 42 minutes.
- Reykjavík: about 104 km by road, about 97 minutes.
- Keflavík Airport: about 140 km by road, about 128 minutes.

## Winter
- Northern lights need dark and partly clear skies (Icelandic Met Office, vedur.is). At the houses the nights are dark enough from about 16 August to 27 April.
- Daylight on 21 December: sunrise 11:15, sunset 15:23 (computed for 64.13 N).
- Northern lights can be watched from anywhere on the property, the hot tubs included. The hosts do not send alerts.
- Winter roads: umferdin.is or phone 1777; alerts and travel plans on safetravel.is. The road from Reykjavík and Keflavík crosses the Hellisheiði pass on Route 1. The drive up to the houses is not cleared on a schedule: a four-wheel-drive car usually does, a small SUV to be sure.
- The Secret Lagoon, Laugarás Lagoon and Hrunalaug are open every day in winter.
